SALES CONTRACT

Between Nordlicht Trade d.o.o., Belgrade (the "Seller") and Gulf Horizon Trading LLC, Dubai (the "Buyer"). Invented for testing.

1. Delivery
1.1 The Seller shall deliver the goods DDP Dubai (Incoterms 2010).
1.2 Delivery terms DAT Jebel Ali Terminal apply to the second shipment.

2. Payment
2.1 The Buyer shall pay the price within 90 days after delivery.

3. Warranty
3.1 The Seller warrants the goods for 36 months from delivery.

4. Liability
4.1 The Seller's liability is unlimited.
4.2 The Seller excludes liability for wilful misconduct.

5. Term
5.1 The Contract renews automatically for successive periods of one year unless a party gives 60 days' notice.

6. Termination
6.1 The Buyer may terminate this Contract for convenience at any time.

7. Governing Law
7.1 This Contract is governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates.

8. Penalties
8.1 The Seller shall pay liquidated damages of 0.2% per day for late delivery.
